general_rule.provider_factory: propagate an exact provider object through constructor field/engine storage; execute getDKWebView only from a reached synchronous call or an actually registered callback; carry callback return into the exact mDKWebView field; call getDKWebView on that same returned provider object to recover the native View
general_rule.non_view_wrapper: a wrapper/interface return is not itself a WebView; require a getter or native field relation proving the exact underlying WebView receiving settings/clients
general_rule.callback_boundary: construction of a Runnable/listener/provider does not activate it. Require Handler.post, DynamicUtils.runOnUiThread, another recognized registration/dispatch pair, or a reached direct call.
general_rule.branch_isolation: separate system and X5 wrapper objects; do not merge by common interface or requested mode; absent reflective X5 classes remain unknown

positive: Provider P is passed into engine E; installed callback C captures E; dispatcher runs C; C calls E.init; E calls P.factory; returned wrapper W is stored; W.getView returns W.native; settings/client on W.native must be attributed to host.
Handler.post(R) where R.run calls listener factory, stores returned non-View page, and page.load creates wrapper: follow exact return and native getter chain.
